== Summary ==
Decipher's "little shop" has some hot items: Star Wars CCG Japanese-language cards, Star Trek CCG The Fajo Collection and (Saturday) Star Wars Enhanced Cloud City! Photo: Decipher. See [[DecipherCon 1999]], [[1999 Decipher World Championship]], [[DecipherCon 1999 photographs]].
